legend.vowel: per frame: a i u e o = open vowel shape, N = moraic nasal (lips parted, tongue up), m = lips closed, - = mouth at rest
legend.vocal_loudness: 0..1, 36 dB range, from Shio's dry solo voice
legend.origin: 'picture' = frame fixed by the animation, 'audio' = placed by the music

lyrics.text: 雪の夜 灯がひとつ

lyrics.text: 結んでくれた 赤い紐
鳴れ 鳴れ 宵の鐘

lyrics.text: 消えない灯を この胸に
lyrics.romaji: kienai hi o / kono mune ni

lyrics.text: 明日の岸へ 渡すまで
lyrics.romaji: asu no kishi e / watasu made
